counter_test_1_headroom_or_biology.verdict: claim survives: where there is room, the starting density does not predict failure

counter_test_2_external_corroboration.verdict: no significant corroboration, but the point estimate is positive and n is 18, so this is underpowered rather than negative
counter_test_2_external_corroboration.caveat: MDK99 is computed from the same T0 reading as the label, so it is not fully independent of it; a shared N0 inflates agreement in the direction of the rival.

counter_test_3_sampling_time_confound.verdict: claim survives: resistance still predicts a lower inoculum with months on treatment in the model

counter_test_4_inversions_or_noise.verdict: does not collapse, but it does erode: the headline 36.6 per cent is the most generous reading, and requiring the rate difference to be real leaves roughly one comparison in five. The manuscript must quote the range, not the maximum.
